articles.image_title: Ostschild: November 30, 2024, Dabrowka, Poland: Concrete barriers that are part of Poland s East Shield fortification at Poland s border with Russia. Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk visited the first completed section of the East Shield Polish Tarcza Wschod, a landmark national defense initiative launched to strengthen Polands eastern borders with Belarus and the Russian exclave of Kaliningrad. This program marks one of the largest investments in national security and border defense in Polands post-war history. During the visit, Tusk emphasized the projects critical role in reinforcing NATOs eastern flank, describing it as a vital component of Polands efforts to enhance regional stability and collective defense capabilities.
